test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined segment in the given sentence.

When it comes to playing the guitar, Jim always __hits the nail on the head.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Does something right**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"hits the nail on the head"** means to do or say something that is exactly right or completely accurate; it often refers to understanding a complex situation in its entirety. (बिल्कुल सही बात कहना या करना)
 
 
 
• **Example: **When she said the project failed due to lack of planning, she really hit the nail on the head.
 
 

 
• **"Does something right" **implies performing an action correctly or in a manner that yields the intended or a successful outcome. (सही ढंग से कुछ करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Every time he's given a task, he does it right, ensuring no details are missed.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the phrase **'hits the nail on the head'** corresponds to **'Does something right'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Does something right**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Is dishonest **(बेईमान होना): Engaging in or promoting untruthful behaviors or actions.

 
 
• **Example:** Anyone found to be dishonest in their dealings with the company faces immediate dismissal.
 
 

 
• **Misses the point **(मुद्दे को नहीं समझना): Fails to understand the essential aspect or main idea of a discussion or situation.

 
 
• **Example: **Despite all the explanations, he still misses the point of the argument.
 
 

 
• **Makes a mistake** (गलती करना): To perform an action or make a decision that is not correct or that leads to an unwanted outcome.

 
 
• **Example:** She made a mistake in her calculations and had to redo the entire budget.
